```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)

library(p8105.datasets)
data("weather_df")
```

Now we have everything we need!

```{r}
weather_df
```

## Scatterplots 

Create my first scatterplot.

```{r}
ggplot(weather_df, aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point()
```

New approach, same plot

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point()
```

Save and edit plot objects. 

```{r}
weather_plot = 
  weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax))
weather_plot
weather_plot + geom_point()
```

## Advanced scatterplots 

Start with the same one and make it fancy 

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, colour = name)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE)
```

What about the `aes` placement?

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name)) 
```

^Ends up looking the same 

Where this starts to make a difference.. 
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name)) + 
  geom_smooth()
```
Now you only have a single blue line running through all of data. 
Because color applies only to the scatterplot, not the line bc not defined in the geom_smooth

Lets facet some things!

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, colour = name)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = .2) + 
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(. ~ name)
```

Lets combine some elements and try a new plot 

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = tmax, color = name)) + 
  geom_point(aes(size = prcp), alpha = .5) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(. ~ name)
```


## Some small notes

How many geoms have to exist? 

You can have whatever geoms you want. 

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE)
```

Gives only smooth geometry 
^This is not the most useful plot though

You can use a neat geom! 

`geom_hex()`
```{r}
library(hexbin)
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_hex()
```

`geom_bin2d()`
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_bin2d()
```

` geom_density2d()`
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_density2d() + 
  geom_point(alpha = .3)
```


## Univariate plots

Histograms 

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin)) + 
  geom_histogram()
```

Can we add color .. 

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, color = name)) + 
  geom_histogram()
```

Not so great^
So.. 

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, fill = name)) + 
  geom_histogram(position = "dodge")
```
^bars are hard to see 

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin)) + 
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_grid(. ~ name)
```
^hard to compare groups 

Lets try a new geometry 

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, fill = name)) +
  geom_density(alpha = .3)
```
